name: ce-seo
description: SEO and agent-readable content for Commerce Engine storefronts using @commercengine/seo. Route records for CMS-owned URLs, head metadata, JSON-LD (Product/ProductGroup with variesBy), canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, and Markdown mirrors across React SPA, Next.js, Astro, SvelteKit, and TanStack Start.
